nodes.label: CI Workflow (multi-arch image builds)
nodes.rationale: Concurrency is grouped on github.ref with cancel-in-progress so only the latest commit builds, avoiding registry cache overwrites. The default multi-arch manifest is assembled from the amd64 image plus the RPi image rather than the generic arm64 image, because the majority of arm64 users are Raspberry Pi users.

nodes.label: Multi-Architecture Accelerator Build Matrix
nodes.rationale: Frigate ships one image variant per accelerator family (standard amd64/arm64, rpi, tensorrt, tensorrt-jp6, rk, rocm, synaptics) built from per-target bake HCL files, because bundling every runtime into one image would be enormous. The variant suffix list in ci.yml must stay in sync with the retag loop in release.yml.

edges.source_location: builds docker/main/Dockerfile target frigate, whose deps stage runs install_deps.sh
